items.title: US-Iran talks continue through Qatar while Washington signals no attack before the midterms
items.summary: CBS News' live coverage and a search summary report that Qatar's foreign ministry says US-Iran negotiations are ongoing despite tension, and that the White House has said the US will not attack Iran ahead of the 3 November midterms. Iran has demanded sanctions relief and an end to threats before talks proper begin. Nothing dated 28 October was found, so treat this as the latest available picture and provisional.
items.why: Gulf tension drives oil prices and investor risk appetite, which shape company hiring budgets and marketing spend.

items.title: Trump warns that pressing Moscow could push Russia closer to Iran
items.summary: Fox News' live coverage from 20 October (eight days ago) says Iran set red lines for talks, including sanctions relief, and reports Trump warning that immediate action against Russia could derail peace talks and deepen Russia's alignment with Tehran. This is older than the three-day window, so read it as background, and details are provisional.
items.why: How the Ukraine war and the Iran conflict interlock affects energy prices and sanctions, which global employers plan around.

items.title: RBI reportedly raised its repo rate by 25 basis points on 7 October, its first hike since 2023
items.summary: Reported on 7 October (three weeks ago): CNBC says the Reserve Bank of India raised the benchmark repo rate by 25 basis points as inflation risks build. Other results the same search returned conflict on the current rate level, so check the RBI's own announcement. No fresher India story with a verifiable link was found today.
items.why: Higher rates raise borrowing costs for companies and can slow campus hiring and marketing budgets.

items.title: Jio Platforms lists today on BSE and NSE at 10 am
items.summary: India TV and HDFC Sky report that Jio Platforms shares, priced at Rs 1,119 after about 22.19 times subscription, debut on the BSE and NSE today, 28 October, at an issue valuation near Rs 10.3 lakh crore. Grey-market premium quotes of roughly Rs 244 to 247 are unofficial and conflict between sources, so they are not a guarantee of the listing price.
items.why: India's largest IPO shows how markets price subscriber scale and brand strength, a useful lens for marketing strategy.

items.title: Sensex and Nifty opened lower on Tuesday ahead of the Jio listing
items.summary: Upstox reports the Nifty 50 and Sensex opened in the red on Tuesday 27 October, with Reliance shares moving ahead of the Jio Platforms listing. Closing levels for 27 and 28 October were not found, so the move is provisional.
items.why: Market swings change campus-hiring sentiment and the risk appetite of recruiting companies.

items.title: OpenAI introduces GPT-6.1 Terra, a faster and cheaper model for computer-use tasks
items.summary: Tech Startups' roundup for 27 October lists OpenAI's GPT-6.1 Terra, aimed at faster, lower-cost computer-based tasks, visual reasoning and software development, with reports of about 50 per cent lower API pricing. The same roundup mentions Microsoft offering voluntary buyouts to about 60,000 employees. These are aggregator reports and company claims, not independently tested.
items.why: Cheaper agent models change which HR and marketing tasks can be automated, and buyouts at this scale reshape talent supply.

items.title: Apple reportedly announced M6 hardware, with a $1,499 iMac shipping 6 November
items.summary: Tech Startups' 27 October roundup reports Apple announced M6 hardware including a $1,499 iMac and a $1,999 14-inch MacBook Pro, both shipping 6 November. This comes from an aggregator and is provisional.
items.why: Pricing and launch timing are core marketing-mix decisions.
